versions.changelog:
quantoracle 2.4.1

- Clarified and expanded metadata around free and paid tiers, daily limits, and x402 payment/wallet requirements.
- Specified that all 63 calculator endpoints have a free usage tier (1,000 calls per IP per day) with no API key required.
- Detailed composite (paid) workflow endpoints, pricing, currencies (USDC), and payment networks (Base and Solana).
- Ensured documentation explicitly describes behavior for non-wallet and wallet-enabled environments, including default 402 error handling.
- Minor update to the main description to highlight free daily quota and paid composite range.

QuantOracle 2.4.0 — expanded tools, new composite workflows, and dual-chain payments:

- Added 10 new composite workflows for strategy backtesting, options analysis, rebalancing, hedging, and more (paid-only features)
- Now supports x402 micropayments via USDC on Base or Solana
- Enhanced documentation with a browser-friendly calculator portal at quantoracle.dev
- Removed build and config files for a streamlined distribution
- Updated pricing and free tier details
- Improved SKILL.md descriptions of capabilities and usage
Initial release: 63 deterministic quant finance tools via MCP
